name: ws-scrcpy-web
description: Browser-based Android screen mirroring and control, powered by scrcpy
author: bilbospocketses

scripts.build: npm run clean && webpack --config webpack/ws-scrcpy-web.prod.ts --stats-error-details && npm run build:types
scripts.stage-seed: node scripts/stage-seed-node-pty.mjs && node scripts/stage-seed-scrcpy-server.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs
scripts.start: npm run stage-seed && npm run build && node scripts/dev-supervisor.mjs
scripts.package:pack: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'win32') { console.log('package:pack is Windows-only; use package:linux for AppImage'); process.exit(0); } const cp = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const v = process.env.npm_package_version; const channel = v.includes('-beta') ? 'beta' : 'stable'; const started = Date.now(); import('./scripts/vpk-path.mjs').then(m => { const r = cp.spawnSync(m.ensureVpk(), ['pack','--packId','WsScrcpyWeb','--packVersion',v,'--packDir','publish','--mainExe','ws-scrcpy-web-launcher.exe','--packTitle','ws-scrcpy-web','--packAuthors','ws-scrcpy-web contributors','--channel',channel,'--icon','assets/tray-icon.ico','--msi','--instLocation','PerMachine','-o','Releases'], {stdio:'inherit'}); if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1); const msis = fs.readdirSync('Releases').filter(f => f.endsWith('.msi')).map(f => path.join('Releases', f)).filter(f => fs.statSync(f).mtimeMs >= started - 1000); if (msis.length === 0) { console.error('package:pack: vpk pack wrote no MSI'); process.exit(1); } for (const msi of msis) { const p = cp.spawnSync('pwsh', ['-NoProfile','-File','scripts/msi-default-programfiles.ps1','-Msi',path.resolve(msi)], {stdio:'inherit'}); if (p.error) console.error('package:pack: could not run pwsh: ' + p.error.message); if (p.status !== 0) process.exit(p.status ?? 1); } });"
